title: HackerRank: Staircase
description: Given an integer `n`, generate a right-aligned staircase of size `n` using '#' symbols and spaces. Return the staircase as a list of `n` strings.
solution:
def staircase(n: int) -> list[str]:
    return [(' ' * (n - i) + '#' * i) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
explanation: Right-aligns step i by prefixing (n - i) spaces and i hash symbols in O(N^2) time.
